name: TA866
iocPatterns: Malicious URLs or domains for command and control

Ability to persist and escalate privileges post-compromise
recommendedActions: Implement advanced email filtering solutions to detect spear-phishing attempts.

campaignsText: TA866's campaigns have been active since at least 2019, with notable peaks in 2022. Their operations focus on financial gain through malware distribution but may also involve data exfiltration.
description: TA866 is a newly identified criminal threat actor distributing malware through emails since at least 2019, with heightened activity observed in 2022. Their primary motivation appears to be financial gain, though there are potential espionage activities that could indicate more complex objectives.
goals: TA866 primarily targets sectors that offer high financial rewards or sensitive information, such as banking and finance. Their geographic targeting likely focuses on regions with prevalent cybercrime activity and accessible infrastructure for command-and-control domains, though specific countries are not explicitly detailed.
